evidence_spans: We describe an analog-in-memory-compute macro hybrid-bonding a 14nm logic die onto a 3D NAND Flash memory wafer, achieving weight density of 4.8M weights/mm2.
14nm logic die onto a 3D NAND Flash memory wafer
We describe an analog-in-memory-compute macro hybrid-bonding a 14nm logic die onto a 3D NAND Flash memory wafer, achieving weight density of 4.8M weights/mm2.
CLM-MEM-0060.statement: The hybrid-bonded 3D-NAND-Flash-based analog in-memory-compute macro achieves a weight density of 4.8M weights/mm2.
